as_told.title: Legacy programs used nuclear material as bait for UFOs

plain: Secret long-running US UFO programs have used nuclear material, or even fake nuclear material, as bait to make UFOs show up. Jesse Michels tells this, once in his own words and once crediting Garry Nolan, a microbiologist at Stanford University, and in the second telling he widens it to Russia too, from the middle of the last century into the 1990s. If true, it would mean governments knew UFOs were drawn to nuclear material and used that to lure them.
